RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the July 28, 2006/Sravana 6, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and
Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Environment and Forests; Health and Family Welfare;
Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions —20
Prices of foodgrains for BPL and APL
card holders
 *81. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
SHRI K.E. ISMAIL:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning
to increase the prices of foodgrains for BPL
and APL categories;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government are going to cut down the
foodgrain allocations to both the sections
of ration-card holders; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Curbing the rising prices of pulses
and other food items
*82. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the prices of pulses and other food items
including vegetables have risen abnormally
which are beyond the reach of lower middle
class people;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
specific reasons for the increase despite
bumper crop of wheat and sugarcane in the
country during the current year; and
(c) the action Government have taken
to curb the price rise and the result thereof?
Relief package for suicide
prone areas
*83. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: W ill the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any relief package has been
announced for the suicide prone areas in
the country for the benefit of farmers;
and
(b) if so, the districts likely to be covered
under that package?

27
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Increasing cases of breast cancer
*84. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
breast cancer cases are alarmingly increasing
in the country since last three years;
(b) if so, Government’s views and
reactions thereto;
(c) whether Government have any
proposal for making available breast cancer
screening test at free of cost to ordinary
people of our country;
(d) if so, by when it will be
implemented; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Shifting of Guwahati railway station
*85. SHRIMATI  SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Railway
authorities are considering a proposal for
shifting of the Guwahati Railway Station
from its present site and a proposal has
also been mooted to enlarge the Kamakhya
station and shift the railway line from its
present position to Narengi by the side of
the Kalapahar crossing the Guwahati-
Shillong road;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when this work would be
completed?
Salem Railway Division
*86. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Railways
had decided to bring in the areas now with
the Palakkad Division under Salem Railway
Division;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that no fund
has been allotted for the purpose of Salem
Division; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Development of Jajpur-Keonjhar
Road railway station
*87. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a proposal has been made
by the Finance Minister of Orissa to
develop the Jajpur-Keonjhar Road railway
station taking into account Kalinga Nagar
an industrial hub in the making;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to revamp the above station
to cater to the needs of passengers and
transporters in view of fast
industrialization of this area?
Permission for duty free import of
wheat
†*88. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
permission to private sector for duty free
import of wheat from companies of USA;

28
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the expected price of this
imported wheat per quintal;
(c) whether Government have given
permission to restrict the excess quantity
of weeds and insecticides and to relax
quality standard in the imported wheat;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
‘Beeja Yatra’ by social activists
*89. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
‘Beeja Yatra’ being undertaken by eminent
social activists, to liberate Indian agriculture
from the grip of foreign companies;
(b) the steps being taken to meet the
demands raised in the Yatra; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Committee on working of AIIMS
*90. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRI LALI

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the July 28, 2006/Sravana 6, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and
Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Environment and Forests; Health and Family Welfare;
Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
Corporate investment in agriculture
sector
†400. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to encourage corporate investment in
agriculture sector;
(b) if so, the expected positive impact
of the same in agriculture sector; and
(c) whether it would not adversely affect
the marginal farmers alongwith the steps
that would be taken in view of their
interests?
Assistance to Orissa under National
Horticulture Mission
401. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Orissa Government has
requested for Central assistance for
fourteen districts which are not covered by
the National Horticulture Mission;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the time-frame within which it would
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
be considered and the State Government
would be apprised of the action taken in
the matter?
Making farmers self-reliant
402. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
shortage of food in the country is due to
neglect of farmers;
(b) whether Government are also aware
that about 660 million farmers in the country
are not only food producers but consumers
also;
(c) whether there is any policy to
address the problems faced by farmers for
making them self-reliant; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Self-sufficiency in foodgrains
403. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have reviewed
a recent report of the United Nations Food
94

95
and Agriculture Organisation forecasting
inter-alia a ten million tonne decrease in
world wheat production this year with a
strong demand outlook and prices likely to
remain generally high and volatile;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto,
especially in view of the shortage being
faced in our buffer stocks necessitating
massive import of wheat; and
(c) the details of fresh initiatives being
taken to achieve self-sufficiency in
foodgrains and bridge the demand and
supply gap on a durable basis to protect
the interests of the common man?
Modernisation of fisheries sector
404. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
fisheries sector has vast potential in our
country;
(b) if so, the action plan of Government
to modernize this industry with a view to
fully exploit its potential; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to develop this industry in
the State of Orissa to improve its economy?
ICAR agreement with ICRISAT for
dry land research
405. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the ICAR
had signed a three year agreement with
ICRISAT for farm research in dry land;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the pact
with the ICRISAT will benefit dry land
farmers by improving productivity; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Collaboration between Indian and US
Universities on agricultural research
406. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any university or
organisation has entered into an agreement
with any US based university or
organisation in the field of agricultural
research;
(b) whether there is any clauses or
section in those agreements which deals
with the patenting rights on the results of
research;
(c) the advantages Government seeks
to get out of these combined research; and
(d) the details of agreement entered
between Acharya NG Ranga University for
Agriculture and its counterpart in US?
Agrarian crisis in Kerala
407. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a Central
Planning Commission team had visited
Kerala to study the spiraling agrarian crisis
in the State driving hundreds of farmers to
suicide;
(b) if so, the details and their findings
and recommendations made; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken by
the Central Government to solve the
problems being faced by the farmers in the
State?

96
Crisis in agriculture

Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Hon'ble Prime
Minister's visit to Vidarbha explores farmers
suicides as a result of agrarian crisis;
(b) if so, the safeguards that the
Ministry proposes to implement; and
(c) whether the WTO conditionalities
may be reviewed in the interest of the
farmers to resolve the crisis in the
agricul
